name: supplier
description: Governed dictionary for an enterprise supplier master record.

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.definition: Stable enterprise identifier for one supplier; never reused.

fields.name: legal_name
fields.definition: Current legal name of the supplier recorded in the enterprise supplier master.

fields.name: active_contract_count
fields.definition: Number of active enterprise contracts currently associated with the supplier.

fields.name: strategic
fields.definition: Whether the supplier is formally designated as strategic under the current supplier-management framework.
